You will hear Jo telling her dad where her friends go shopping.
Dad: Does Anna go to the supermarket?
Jo: No, she buys apples at the market.
Dad: Where does Ben go?
Jo: To the bookshop for a story book.
Dad: And Cara?
Jo: She needs a shirt, so she goes to the clothes shop.
Dad: Dan likes toys.
Jo: Yes, he goes to the toy shop today.
Dad: What about Eva?
Jo: She needs a football, so she goes to the sports shop. Then we all meet at the café.
